paragraphs.text: Are you travelling to the Philippines? The most popular form of transport is the jeepney, a colourful bus. The jeepneys in the Philippines are unique. They are very different from buses in other countries.

The original jeepneys were not colourful. They were dull green jeeps. The US Army left them in the country after World War II. Filipinos changed the jeeps into buses. They painted them bright colours. They used cloth, not glass, for side windows. They added enough benches for 20 passengers to sit on.

People who drive jeepneys do not have set schedules or maps. Before you get on a jeepney, you should know your route. You should ask a Filipino person for advice. Most people are helpful and will tell you which jeepney to take.

Riding in a jeepney is not expensive. Find out how much the ride costs before you ride. Most jeepney drivers do not carry a lot of money. The drivers prefer you pay the exact fare. If possible, bring coins or small notes.
There are different ways to tell the driver you want to get off. One way is to call out 'Para po!' This means 'Please stop!' in Tagalog.
